cases.title: Detect hardcoded secret and unsafe eval
cases.code_diff:
diff --git a/app/auth.py b/app/auth.py
--- a/app/auth.py
+++ b/app/auth.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
+API_KEY = "sk-local-eval-secret"
+result = eval(user_input)
